name: prism3d
description: 3D · açık pastel zemin, koyu başlık, gümüş çerçeveli perspektifli telefon, yumuşak gölge.
design_notes: Light, airy 3D look. Very pale tint of the main colour as a soft gradient background; headline in a deep shade of the main colour with the accent word in the saturated main colour. A silver iPhone is tilted in 3D perspective (alternating directions, sometimes two phones overlapping) with a soft, long shadow.
